question: Under what ritual condition, excluding the image, are liṅgas made of flowers and other materials used?
premises: The movable image may be set aside.
Worship can be accomplished with liṅgas made of flowers and other materials.
This applies when such worship is completed.
inference: Therefore, when worship is accomplished with liṅgas of flowers and other materials, the image is left aside.
plain_english: When worship is carried out using liṅgas made of flowers and other materials, leaving aside the image, that condition applies.
